messages:
maria: Heads up — canary (NF4+FP4) went live in us-west-2 ~5m ago. Perf dashboard shows intermittent throughput drops on a subset of p3d hosts.
alex: seeing the same. batching rate oscillates 16 -> 4 -> 1 reqs per batch, KV hit rate drops to ~60% briefly. https://console.redwood.internal/perf
ken: can you paste a profiler snapshot or p99 traces?
maria: quick perf snippet:
```
host=host-42, 14:23:01 UTC
p99 latency: 1.9s -> 3.8s spike
token throughput: 1800 tok/s -> 600 tok/s
kv_cache_hit: 95% -> 58%
kernel_selector: nf4_fastpath OK -> fallback_count=37
```
sre-oncall: noticed memory spike on host-42 at the same time, kernel out-of-memory events and short-lived page faults.
alex: reading the trace — kernel selector toggling to fp32 slowpath for some attention matmuls when seq_len > 1024 on mixed-precision batches; that triggers an allocation path that thrashes KV slab and forces evictions.
maria: repro: run long prompts (~2000 tokens) with mixed-quant + autoscale batching. autoscaler collapse to batch_size=1 for ~10s windows.
ken: hypothesis: quant kernel chooses 'slowpath' when per-op calibration variance > threshold; scheduler reduces batching to keep latency SLO -> throughput collapse. repeated evictions fragment KV reservoir.
alex: temporary mitigation: pin kernel selector to prefer nf4_fastpath for canary and disable dynamic fallback heuristic. pushing override now.
deploy-bot: deploy: kernel-selector override applied to canary-group by alex at 1945003000 — rollout healthy.
maria: after override, batching stabilized (16 steady), KV hit back to ~95%, throughput recovered to ~1850 tok/s :thumbsup:
ken: longer term actions:
- add guardrail in selector to avoid fallback oscillation if kv_eviction_rate > 0.5%
- telemetry: emit kernel_fallback_count/min and kv_eviction_rate per host
- adjust seq_len threshold logic to consider active kv-reservoir utilization
alex: opening PERF-1421 with traces + minimal repro harness. quick config note: --seq-cutoff=1024 and --fallback-debounce-ms=500
maria: will monitor canary for 24h and add notes to postmortem if we see recurrence. tagging infra & runtime for follow-up.
